newsitem.title: USA: AT&T, Incite in multimedia solution pact.
newsitem.headline: AT&T, Incite in multimedia solution pact.

text.p: AT&T Corp said it has joined forces with Incite Co to deliver a local area network-based (LAN), turn-key multivendor solution that enables businesses to conduct collaborative voice, video and data applications from their workstations.

The company said the co-marketing agreement unites AT&T's Switched Digital Service integrated services digital network with Incite's conversational media system, which provides LAN-based connectivity and desktop applications.

In addition to providing a cost-effective way to support simultaneous voice and video communications, other applications include file sharing, high-quality video playback, remote server access and home office applications.
AT&T said these applications will be valuable to banks and financial institutions, hospitals and healthcare providers, government agencies, educational facilities and manufacturers.
